items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: So, Walter Winchell gotten ahol'...got to mention it

ctx.x:
So I had a bean I carried I got from a cat in
Kansas City I was carrying around with me, supposed to be a lucky bean.
You rub it and make your wish an' come true. So Barney Josephson's band
...when it would get slow, Barney Josephson walked up to me, said, "Where's
that bean you got? Let me rub that bean." (Laughs). So I let him rub it.
He went away feelin' good, you know. Sure enough, later on that night,
the joint was packed an' jammed.
So, Walter Winchell gotten ahol'...got to mention it, and I hadda...I
was…
Did it ever work for you?
